about.heading: From Mumbai's Yoga Mats to Israel's Top Medical Centers
about.p1: Dr. Victor Duani's path to chiropractic began through yoga in Mumbai in 2004, where he discovered the deep connection between movement, rehabilitation, and spinal health. He went on to graduate from the Durban University of Technology (DUT) School of Chiropractic in South Africa in 2010.
about.p2: After returning to Israel, Dr. Duani worked as a chiropractor at Assaf Harofeh Medical Center and managed rehabilitative chiropractic at Sheba Medical Center, Tel Hashomer, while simultaneously serving in the IDF Medical Corps reserves as a chiropractor for the air crew. Today he runs his private clinics in Tel Aviv and Tuval, specializing in rehabilitative chiropractic for orthopedic problems, spinal maintenance and care, and sports injuries.
credentials: Doctor of Chiropractic, DUT, South Africa
IDF Medical Corps, Air Crew Chiropractor

services.heading: Comprehensive Rehabilitative Care
services.sub: A holistic approach combining classic chiropractic with advanced rehabilitation techniques, focused on your back, joints, and head.

items.title: Kinesio & Neurodynamic Taping
items.desc: Strategic taping techniques that support muscles, improve circulation, and facilitate the body's natural healing process.

items.title: Yoga-Based Rehabilitation
items.desc: Targeted stretches and yoga exercises designed specifically for pain release, increased mobility, and spinal recovery.

items.desc: Firm + soft therapy balls for targeted trigger-point release in the back, shoulders, and feet.
items.details: Includes one firm lacrosse-style ball (6.5 cm) and one softer textured ball (7.5 cm). Use against a wall or on the floor for self-massage of deep knots. Targets trigger points in the upper back, shoulder blades, glutes, and plantar fascia. Portable, fits in any bag.

items.name: Hot & Cold Gel Pack
items.desc: Reusable gel compress for heat or cold therapy. Soothes inflammation, muscle spasms, and joint stiffness.
items.details: Medical-grade non-toxic gel, 25 × 15 cm with soft fabric cover. Microwave for heat therapy (muscle tension, stiffness) or freeze for cold therapy (swelling, acute injury). Flexible even when frozen. Reusable hundreds of times.

items.name: Kinesiology Tape Roll
items.desc: Elastic therapeutic tape that supports muscles and joints without restricting movement. Waterproof, lasts 3–5 days.
items.details: 5 m × 5 cm roll of latex-free, hypoallergenic cotton tape with medical-grade acrylic adhesive. Provides support and proprioceptive feedback without limiting range of motion. Waterproof and sweat-resistant, so it stays on during showers and workouts. Used professionally for sports injuries, postural taping, and lymphatic drainage.

faq.label: Questions
faq.p: Short answers from the clinic's articles. Each one links to the full piece.

items.q: How many sessions will I need?
items.a: It depends on the problem and how long you've had it. A recent problem often takes 4–8 sessions; a chronic one 10–20 over a few months. You get a realistic estimate after the assessment, and visits get less frequent as you improve.

When a licensed, properly trained chiropractor treats patients who have been screened first, it has an excellent safety record. Adjustments are low-force, controlled movements, and the assessment checks for anything that needs a different approach.

items.q: Does the cracking sound mean something is wrong?
items.a: No. The pop is a small gas bubble releasing inside the joint fluid, the same thing that happens when you crack your knuckles. Many effective adjustments make no sound at all.

items.q: Will I have to keep coming forever?
items.a: No. Treatment has a defined goal and an end point. Some patients choose occasional maintenance visits, but that is a choice, not a requirement.

items.q: What happens at the first appointment?
items.a: A conversation about your history, a physical exam of posture, movement and nerve function, then an explanation of what's causing the problem and the plan to treat it.
